How long Wasted waits after the screen turns off or the phone locks before firing the Lock trigger. Use d for days, h for hours, m for minutes (for example 7d, 48h, 120m).

Remote Management can turn the Lock trigger on or off and change this delay for all enrolled devices. The countdown starts after screen-off/lock and stops when you unlock. When it completes, Wasted locks the phone; if Wipe data is ON locally, the reset starts, unless Debug Mode blocks it. Wipe data itself is not changed by Remote Management.
Safe delay before it will fire. Gives you some time to cancel fire if you will tap a tile accidentally.

Enable panic responder. PanicKit is a collection of tools for creating “panic buttons” that can trigger a system-wide response when the user is in an anxious or dangerous situation. It enables trigger apps and responder apps to safely and easily connect to each other. The user engages with the trigger app when in a panic situation. The responder apps receive that trigger signal, and individually execute the steps that they were configured to do.
Enable tile service. It is a button in quick settings panel when you swipe from the top of the screen. This button will mimic to the airplane mode.
Enable icon shortcut. It is a button you will see when you make a long tap on the Wasted icon.
Enable broadcast receiver. It is useful to communicate with another Android apps. For example you can fire Wasted from Tasker using this.
Enable device notification listener. It will scan all notifications it has access to for the secret code. When found it will fire.

Lock trigger. Enable the lock job scheduler. It schedules a job when you turn off the screen and cancels it when you unlock the phone. If the phone stays locked for the Lock delay (set under Lock delay in the menu), the job fires. Remote Management can turn this Lock trigger on or off and change that delay account-wide.

USB trigger. When enabled, a USB data connection while the phone is locked fires the trigger. It does not fire on a charger, only on a USB device or accessory. Remote Management can change this account-wide; changing it in this phone\'s Settings changes only this phone.
Enable fake application. It will add fake messenger applications. Launching them will fire Wasted.
Instead of wipe data you may want to send a broadcast message.
⚡ Strong — App data cleared + TRIM on trigger
📁 Partial — Photos and files deleted on trigger
Ask for biometrics or your device credential when Wasted opens. Turn this off to open the app without a prompt.
Requires Device Admin. Locks the screen only; it does not wipe data or change any trigger setting.
This locks the screen. It does not wipe data or change any settings.
Send the lock command now? You will need to unlock the phone locally.
Device Admin must be active before Wasted can lock the screen.
Optional decoy icons. Opening one fires Wasted like a trigger; these are not real messaging apps.
Wasted reads notifications it has access to and fires when the secret code appears. Use Notification access in Android settings to grant or revoke it.

WHAT THIS SCREEN DOES

Wasted locks and optionally resets this phone when a configured trigger fires. This screen controls the code and what a reset includes.

SECRET CODE

• The large code is the secret used by notification and other code-based triggers. Keep it private.
• The code background is red when no trigger is enabled and yellow when at least one is. Wipe data alone does not change it.

TOP BUTTONS

• Copy — copies the code.
• Edit — changes the code.
• Settings — opens Wasted settings.

WIPE OPTIONS

• Wipe data — when Wasted fires, it locks the phone and starts a reset. If off, it only locks.
• Wipe eSIM — also erases the eSIM when supported. Available when Wipe data is on.
• Protection Level — how complete the reset will be on this phone.
• Setup card — the next step for stronger protection.

BOTTOM BUTTON

• ON — arms Wasted. Device Admin must be active.
• OFF — disarms Wasted; triggers do nothing.

WHEN IT FIRES

With Wasted ON, a matching trigger locks the phone. If Wipe data is on, it then starts the reset.
Also: grant All Files Access for file deletion on wipe
